svg.aria-label: Phenomenology, risk, capacity, and medical safety

g.text: Loosening makes links hard to follow
Months backward and digit span catch
Delusion counts only if it blocks
Diagnosis or test score is not a
Handover: what changed, what to do
Most are not violent, more often
Reduced need for sleep: the person
Organic red flags in first episode
Tests chosen by phenotype, not a
Risk from rate of loss, not
Uncertainty must not blur the safety
